SELECT me.id, me.company_id, me.order_id, me.record_year, me.record_month, me.record_day, me.energy_id, me.energy_usage, me.del_flag, me.create_by, me.create_time, me.update_by, me.update_time, me.remark , et.energy_name as energyName FROM monitoring_energy me LEFT JOIN energy_type et ON me.energy_id = et.id

mapper.select: SELECT et.id AS energyId, et.energy_name AS energyName, et.energy_unit AS energyUnit, SUM(me.energy_usage) AS energyUsage FROM monitoring_energy me left JOIN energy_type et ON me.energy_id = et.id WHERE me.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{hour} HOUR) AND me.company_id = #{companyId} AND me.del_flag = '0' AND et.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY et.id, et.energy_name, et.energy_unit

SELECT et.energy_name, me.record_day AS record_day, SUM(me.energy_usage) AS energy_usage FROM monitoring_energy me JOIN energy_type et ON me.energy_id = et.id WHERE me.record_year = #{recordYear} AND me.record_month = #{recordMonth} AND me.company_id = #{companyId} AND me.del_flag = '0' AND et.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY et.energy_name, me.record_year, me.record_month, me.record_day ORDER BY me.record_year, me.record_month, me.record_day

SELECT om.steel_spec AS steelSpec, me.record_day AS record_day, me.energy_usage FROM monitoring_energy me JOIN energy_type et ON me.energy_id = et.id JOIN order_main om ON me.order_code = om.order_code WHERE et.energy_name = #{energyName} AND me.record_year = #{recordYear} AND me.record_month = #{recordMonth} AND me.company_id = #{companyId} AND me.del_flag = '0' AND et.del_flag = '0' AND om.del_flag = '0'
